title: A Local Proof of Langlands's Second Main Lemma for Local Epsilon Factors over Nonarchimedean Local Fields
summary: We give a local proof of Langlands's Second Main Lemma for local epsilon factors over nonarchimedean local fields. The lemma compares the induction expressions attached to compatible characters of distinct intermediate fields of prime degree in a bicyclic extension of prime-square degree. It is one of the main identities used in Langlands's construction of epsilon factors of local Weil representations. The proof builds on the work of Dwork, Lakkis, and Langlands.
